title: Separate AuthListenable ChangeNotifier from AuthRepository
objective: Remove the ChangeNotifier inheritance from AuthRepository and introduce a dedicated AuthListenable wrapper class that owns notifyListeners() — wiring it to GoRouter.refreshListenable in main_app.dart instead of the repository itself.
description: Today AuthRepository extends ChangeNotifier (lib/data/repositories/auth/auth_repository.dart line 14) and calls notifyListeners() in the finally block of login / signUp / logout / resetPassword (lines 150, 217, 240, 256). This conflates two responsibilities: data access (the repo) and reactivity-broadcast (the listener). The fix introduces lib/data/repositories/auth/auth_listenable.dart with `class AuthListenable extends ChangeNotifier { void notify() => notifyListeners(); }`, removes `extends ChangeNotifier` from AuthRepository and removes every notifyListeners() call inside the repo, updates IAuthRepository to drop the ChangeNotifier inheritance (it currently has `extends ChangeNotifier` on line 7 of iauth_repository.dart), and updates main_app.dart to wrap AuthListenable in a Provider + Listenable so GoRouter.refreshListenable can reference it. The DI in lib/config/dependencies.dart wires AuthListenable around AuthRepository so that login / signUp / logout can call `context.read<AuthListenable>().notify()` after mutating auth state.

reference_files.reason: Drop `extends ChangeNotifier` (line 14). Drop every notifyListeners() call (lines 150, 217, 240, 256). Update the constructor so it does NOT require AuthListenable — keep the constructor parameter-free for the existing DI wiring.
Drop `extends ChangeNotifier` (line 7). The interface should not inherit from any UI-framework class.
GoRouter takes `refreshListenable: authRepository`. After this subtask, it must take a dedicated Listenable — pass `authListenable` instead, plumbed via the DI graph.
router(context.read()) — currently reads IAuthRepository. After this subtask, it must read AuthListenable (a separate DI entry).
The ChangeNotifierProvider<IAuthRepository> block. Restructure to: Provider<IAuthRepository> + ChangeNotifierProvider<AuthListenable> wrapping the same instance.

fix_shape.auth_listenable_new_file: lib/data/repositories/auth/auth_listenable.dart — declares `import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';` and exposes `class AuthListenable extends ChangeNotifier { void notify() => notifyListeners(); }`. Public method name is `notify` so callers don't accidentally invoke `notifyListeners` directly.
fix_shape.auth_repository_changes: Remove `extends ChangeNotifier`. Remove every `notifyListeners();` line in the finally blocks of login (line 150), signUp (line 217), logout (line 240), and resetPassword (line 256). Leave all other logic untouched.
fix_shape.iauth_repository_changes: Remove `extends ChangeNotifier` (line 7). The interface no longer inherits from any Flutter class — pure abstract.
fix_shape.dependencies_changes: Replace the `ChangeNotifierProvider<IAuthRepository>(...)` block with: `Provider<IAuthRepository>(create: (context) => AuthRepository(...))` followed by `ChangeNotifierProvider<AuthListenable>(create: (context) => AuthListenable())`. Callers that need to broadcast (the router and any cubit that listens to auth changes) read AuthListenable.
fix_shape.callers_must_notify: The router's `refreshListenable` is updated to listen to AuthListenable. After login/signUp/logout/resetPassword mutate the repo, the cubit or widget that called the mutation must invoke `context.read<AuthListenable>().notify()`. If no widget currently orchestrates that, add a thin wrapper (e.g. AuthCubit wraps the repository calls and broadcasts via Listenable).

acceptance_criteria: AuthRepository no longer extends ChangeNotifier — `rg -n 'extends ChangeNotifier' lib/data/repositories/auth/auth_repository.dart` returns zero matches
IAuthRepository no longer extends ChangeNotifier — same grep against iauth_repository.dart returns zero matches
AuthRepository has zero notifyListeners() calls — `rg -n 'notifyListeners' lib/data/repositories/auth/auth_repository.dart` returns zero matches
lib/data/repositories/auth/auth_listenable.dart exists with a public `class AuthListenable extends ChangeNotifier` and a `void notify()` method
GoRouter.refreshListenable in router.dart is wired to AuthListenable (not directly to AuthRepository)
lib/config/dependencies.dart provides both IAuthRepository (plain Provider) and AuthListenable (ChangeNotifierProvider)
The router redirect still fires after login / logout (manual smoke test or a code-path trace)
flutter analyze lib/ returns no errors

grep_evidence: rg -n 'extends ChangeNotifier' lib/data/repositories/auth/ returns exactly 1 match (the new AuthListenable class only)
rg -n 'notifyListeners' lib/data/repositories/auth/ returns exactly 1 match (inside AuthListenable.notify() only)

no_op_outside_scope: Do not change AuthRepository's public method signatures (login/signUp/logout/resetPassword/validateSession/currentUuid/currentMember/isAuthenticated). Do not touch any cubit that consumes IAuthRepository — they continue to do so.
